candidates.desc: A cartoon botanist in a greenhouse admires a giant green leaf, tracing its glowing veins in wonder. He presses it flat on a table, and when water suddenly pours from above he holds the huge leaf over his head like an umbrella.
A woman picks blueberries from tall leafy bushes on a berry farm when a blackbird suddenly flutters out of the branches and startles her; a man joins her and they taste the berries together.
A woman in a garden strains to pull a comically huge carrot out of a raised bed, rinses the dirt off with a watering can while a man helps, then bites into the giant carrot with a loud crunch.

A red-haired woman in a mustard sweater sits by a window holding a paper-wrapped bouquet of pink and white flowers. She touches a pink rose, then holds a single pink daisy-like flower up to the camera and by her face, saying she gives you a pretty flower.
A woman in an apron tours her backyard garden at sunset: she waters lettuce beds, picks a ripe tomato by the greenhouse, shells fresh peas into her palm and smells the pink roses.
A man in gloves does gardening in a raised bed: he digs a hole, un-pots a seedling, plants and waters it, then later picks a ripe tomato, bites into it and high-fives his gardening partner.

Two barefoot teenagers stand on a freshly mown striped lawn, try to whistle through blades of grass held between their thumbs, laugh, then flop down and stretch out side by side on the soft green lawn.
In an orchard, a man leans a wooden ladder against an apple tree and holds it steady while a young woman climbs the rungs, picks a red apple from a high branch, and they both take a bite.

In an autumn forest, a couple with a wicker basket crouches over the leaf-covered ground where the woman points out a cluster of brown mushrooms with dewy caps. They then find a bright red mushroom with white spots glowing in the sunbeams and marvel at it without picking it, while a squirrel darts past.

In a bright plant-filled apartment, a woman waters a potted plant with a gold watering can, wipes its big green leaves with a cloth, then she and a man excitedly point at a fresh new leaf shooting up from a pot while a cat watches.

Two young people kneel at the mossy stone edge of a small garden pond ringed by ferns and purple irises. They point excitedly ("Oh wow. Whoa!") at orange goldfish gliding under the lily pads, and a fish splashes, sending ripples across the still water.

In a vegetable garden, a man levers a leafy potato plant out of the dark soil with a spade ("Easy and lift!") and golden potatoes tumble from its roots. A woman kneels down, picks the potatoes out of the dirt admiring how many there are, and together they fill a metal bucket with the harvest.
In a misty rose field at sunrise a woman cradles a large pink rose in her hands, closes her eyes to smell it with delight, then holds up its long stem and points carefully at the sharp thorns.

Farm workers in sun hats kneel in a field at dawn, transplanting seedlings along a stretched string so the plants form a perfectly straight line; a drone shot reveals dozens of workers planting one long straight line across the field. One says the line is nice and even.

A couple burns a pile of autumn leaves in their backyard; a huge column of thick grey smoke billows up, drifts over the man until he is completely wrapped in it, and he coughs and waves it away while the woman laughs.

On a rooftop terrace at sunset, a couple fills a metal watering can at a tap and pours water over their potted tomatoes and herbs. A droopy basil plant gets a good shower and they lean in happily as it revives.

Macro shot in a rain-wet garden bed: a pink earthworm rises out of the dark soil under big green leaves, wriggles across the dirt past a small snail and pebbles, then burrows back down until only its tail tip sticks up. Music only, no speech.

A sunny back yard behind a house, closed in on all sides by a tall wooden fence, with a brick paved path along the house and a patch of green and dry grass in front of it. A pale golden retriever puppy comes trotting along the brick paving towards the camera, ears flapping and tongue out, then steps down off the paving onto the grass of the yard and keeps coming, tail up. It bounds the last few steps through the grass and drops down right in front of the lens, filling the frame with its face, panting happily in the sunshine.

A woman in a bright patterned tunic and blue headscarf stands over a raised bed of bone-dry earth in a courtyard full of terracotta pots. The soil is pale and split into a web of deep cracks. Wearing gardening gloves she tips water from a clay jug and then from a brass watering can; the water vanishes straight into the cracks, spreading dark wet patches until the whole bed is soaked and brown.

A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.

An allotment garden under a grey sky. An older man in a flat cap and body warmer tips a black bucket of kitchen scraps onto a heap inside a wooden compost bin: carrot tops, apples and banana skins scatter over the surface. He then works a spade into the heap and lifts up great forkfuls of dark crumbly earth, turning it over so the older, rotted material underneath comes to the top. Raised beds of cabbages and a greenhouse stand behind him.

An elderly woman in a straw hat, blue cardigan and a floral apron pushes open a wooden garden gate under an archway of roses and comes down the path. She walks between tall pink and white hollyhocks, then bends over a bed of tomato plants tied to bamboo canes and turns the ripe red fruit over in her hand. Further along she works between beds of marigolds and dahlias beside a wheelbarrow heaped with cut flowers, then stands in the middle of the beds and throws her arms open.

In a vegetable garden a hand takes a big red tomato off a staked plant hung with green and red fruit. A man drops the tomato into a wicker basket that already holds cucumbers and more tomatoes. In the next shot a man turns the soil with a spade and pale potatoes come up out of the dark earth. A woman in a headscarf kneels behind a full basket and holds a large potato up to the camera in surprise, and finally a couple tip a basket of peppers onto a wheelbarrow already heaped with tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers and potatoes.

Gloved hands press the soil around a small green seedling just set into a terracotta pot on a patio, with other pots and plants behind. Cut to a watering can pouring a wide spray over a raised bed packed with orange, pink and purple flowers beside a wooden house. Then a woman in gloves closes a pair of red secateurs on a stem inside a tall glossy hedge. Next she bends over a vegetable patch and takes hold of a large orange pumpkin among the broad leaves, and finally she straightens up holding the pumpkin against her chest and grins.

Two young people work outdoors in a sunny hillside garden, bent over a long raised wooden bed filled with dark soil. He presses small green seedlings into the soil one by one while she loosens the earth beside him with a hand trowel, and a row of identical seedlings appears down the length of the bed. A wide shot shows several parallel raised beds, one of them already planted, and the two of them stepping back with their tools to look at the finished rows.

A young woman in a cream cardigan sits at a kitchen table biting into a chocolate-chip cookie, a plate of more cookies in front of her and fairy lights strung on the wall behind. Something makes her look up; she gets up, still holding the cookie, and pads down the hallway to the front door in slippers. She presses her face to the peephole and squints through it. She opens the door and a delivery man in an orange high-visibility jacket and helmet is standing there holding an enormous bunch of sunflowers — big round yellow heads on long green stems. Her mouth falls open in delight and she takes the bunch in both arms.

A man's open palm fills the frame holding one small pale seed that has split open, with a white root curling out of it and two tiny green leaves. He crouches over a black seed tray of soil blocks where the same seeds have pushed up as bent green shoots, laughing and pointing at one of them with his finger. The shot pulls back to show him standing behind the tray of seedlings with a large green field stretching to the horizon behind him at dusk.

An elderly man in a flat cap and body warmer stands at a greenhouse windowsill holding a metal watering can over a terracotta flowerpot with a pale green succulent growing in it. He then waters a garden bed full of pink, yellow and red zinnias and pansies from the same can, moves on to a raised bed of leafy vegetables and waters those too, and finally stands back with a hand on his hip looking over the watered garden.

In an open farm shed, a young man in a denim shirt and white T-shirt holds a big bunch of long-stemmed sunflowers and ties the stems together with twine from a spool on the wet metal table in front of him. Then he lifts the finished bundle upright, holds it out and swings it onto his shoulder. Leaves, petals and another bundle of sunflowers lie on the table, two older men work behind him and a field of sunflowers stretches away outside.

A huge sunflower field on a hot sunny day. A young woman with a ponytail, in a white shirt and rust shorts, stands on a wooden crate with her hands cupped around her mouth, calling out across the tall flowers. Then she shades her eyes with one hand, looks out over the field searching, and smiles. An empty red dog lead lies on the crate at her feet. In the distance stand a stone farmhouse, dark cypress trees and an old cart under a clear blue sky.
